summary: Validated new Stripe billing/checkout flow (Emergent-managed test key sk_test_emergent) end-to-end. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_billing_checkout.py: 11/12 PASS. PASSED: POST /api/billing/checkout with plan='pro' returns 200 {url:'https://checkout.stripe.com/...', session_id}, plan='studio' likewise; invalid plan 'enterprise' returns 400; no-auth returns 401/403; GET /api/billing/checkout/status/{session_id} on a fresh session returns {status:'open', payment_status:'unpaid', paid:false, plan:'pro'}; unknown session id returns 404; another user's session id returns 404 (proper user-scoped enforcement); POST /api/billing/cancel returns {ok:true, plan:'free'} and GET /api/billing/summary immediately reflects plan.id=='free' + currentPeriodEnd==None; GET /api/billing/summary returns stripeEnabled:true, plans[] contains free/pro/studio and usage[] rows (projects computed live). FAILED (1): POST /api/billing/webhook with a signature-less JSON body (checkout.session.completed, payment_status='paid') returns 400 {'detail':'Invalid webhook'} — the review spec explicitly requires this path to return {received:true} via the Emergent proxy. Root cause: server.py:1147-1152 calls sc.handle_webhook(payload, sig) which rejects a missing/invalid Stripe-Signature header and raises, and the FastAPI handler then propagates a 400 instead of tolerating unsigned-proxy events. Frontend E2E (mobile viewport 390x844, logged in as sb_1785767871@studio.com): /login renders (testIDs login-email, login-password, login-submit), Continue takes user to /dashboard; /billing loads and shows Current plan hero ('Free · €0 forever · No renewal (Free plan)'), Usage this period bars (Projects 1/3, AI generations 6/20, Storyboard images 0/10, Exports 0/5), Cloud Storage card '0 MB / 5 GB' with progress bar, Plan limits and Compare plans (plan-card-free / plan-card-pro / plan-card-studio all present, upgrade-btn present, cancel-plan-btn correctly ABSENT on free plan); /pricing loads with 3 plan cards (plan-free/plan-pro/plan-studio) and upgrade-pro / upgrade-studio buttons and pricing-back; clicking upgrade-pro fires POST /api/billing/checkout -> 200 and the browser is redirected to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a1yfW2A4XsktmvW06Z0WD1JT7F0yx9oYTDDZhh4GFSfK6fSLO20Ymbt1Ig showing €19.00 in Stripe Sandbox (Apple Pay + Card form). No card details were entered per the review instructions. Cleanup: seed account sb_1785767871@studio.com was reset back to plan 'free' after tests (POST /api/billing/cancel returned {ok:true,plan:'free'}, /billing/summary confirms plan.id='free', currentPeriodEnd=None).

minor.issue: Signature-less JSON payload (checkout.session.completed with payment_status='paid') returns 400 {'detail':'Invalid webhook'} instead of the spec-required 200 {received:true}. server.py:1147-1152 calls sc.handle_webhook(payload, sig) which raises when the Stripe-Signature header is missing (as happens when Emergent's proxy forwards test-key events). Suggested fix: wrap the sc.handle_webhook call so a missing/invalid signature does NOT abort the request — either accept the JSON body directly when STRIPE_API_KEY starts with 'sk_test_emergent' (proxy path) or try/except and return {received:true} regardless of parse failures (Stripe's own recommendation is to always 200 the webhook and process asynchronously). Priority: MEDIUM — the real activation path (status polling in billing_checkout_status) works and was validated by the main agent, so end-users on the checkout redirect flow are not blocked. Only the async webhook fallback is affected.

action_items: FIX (medium): Make POST /api/billing/webhook tolerant of signature-less requests coming through the Emergent Stripe proxy. Recommended: try/except around sc.handle_webhook — on failure, attempt to json.loads(payload) and, if it looks like a checkout.session.completed with payment_status=='paid' and a known session_id in metadata, still activate the plan idempotently; regardless of outcome return 200 {received:true}. server.py:1143-1159.
MINOR (carry-over from iter14-16): Migrate remaining shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence the console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py billing_checkout (line 1094) — GOOD: server-controlled PLAN_PRICES dict, correct 400 for invalid plans, 503 when STRIPE_API_KEY missing, metadata includes user_id/plan/kind so downstream activation is unambiguous. Payment transaction row is inserted BEFORE returning the URL so status polling has a record even if the user closes the tab.

/app/backend/server.py billing_checkout_status (line 1124) — GOOD: user_id is compared against the tx owner before returning any Stripe status (prevents cross-user session enumeration; verified by test_status_other_user_session_returns_404). Idempotent: only calls _activate_plan when payment_status=='paid' AND not tx.get('processed').

/app/backend/server.py billing_webhook (line 1143) — ISSUE: raises HTTPException(400) whenever sc.handle_webhook fails, which contradicts the review spec requiring {received:true} on the signature-less Emergent-proxy path. Stripe best-practice is to always return 200 to the webhook and process failures out-of-band; the current implementation risks Stripe disabling the endpoint after too many 400s.
/app/backend/server.py billing_cancel (line 1162) — GOOD: idempotent, clears provider + currentPeriodEnd, verified by test_cancel_downgrades_to_free.

/app/frontend/app/pricing.tsx onUpgrade (line 51) — verified: fetches origin (window.location.origin on web), calls api.startCheckout, then window.location = url on web. Confirmed via network capture: POST /api/billing/checkout -> 200 -> redirect to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...

rca_of_issue: RCA: /api/billing/webhook 400 on signature-less payload. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BASE/api/billing/webhook -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"type":"checkout.session.completed","data":{"object":{"id":"cs_test_x","payment_status":"paid","metadata":{}}}}'` -> HTTP 400 {'detail':'Invalid webhook'}. Cause: server.py:1149 `event = await sc.handle_webhook(payload, sig)` raises when sig is None (Stripe SDK signature verification failure); the enclosing try/except turns this into HTTPException(400). Mitigation for main agent: catch the exception, fall back to json.loads(payload) parsing, look up the session by data.object.id, and if metadata.user_id + payment_status=='paid' AND tx not processed, call _activate_plan idempotently; always return {received:true} with 200 so Stripe (and Emergent proxy) do not disable the endpoint. Additionally, guard against duplicate delivery via the existing tx.processed flag (already in place).
